project_name: OpsPilot AI — Enterprise AI Operations, Workflow & Risk Automation Platform
descriptor: An AI agent that analyses organisational operations, identifies inefficiencies and risks, automates workflows, and measures financial and operational impact.

requirements.statement: The system must connect to Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace to access emails and documents.
The system must connect to CRM and ticketing systems to gather customer and request data.
The system must analyse business processes to identify inefficiencies such as bottlenecks and duplicated activities.
The system must identify potential automation opportunities within business workflows.
The system must perform risk assessments for AI systems in the organisation.
The system must maintain an AI system inventory including system, department, purpose, risk, owner, and status.
The system must provide human-in-the-loop controls for high-risk actions.
The system must log all actions and decisions for audit purposes.
The system must calculate estimated ROI based on user-provided assumptions.
The system must allow users to upload documents such as invoices and contracts for structured information extraction.
The system must connect to MCP servers for tool interactions such as finance and HR operations.
The system must support multi-agent orchestration for process, risk, and finance operations.
The system must provide a dashboard to display process analysis results and automation opportunities.
The system must simulate workflows using synthetic data for demonstration purposes.
The system must provide configurable governance controls adaptable to different jurisdictions.
The system must perform privacy assessments for AI systems in the organisation.
The system must support real-time risk assessment for ongoing operations.
The system must provide a workflow builder for users to design and automate processes.

releases.demo: Show integration with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, and demonstrate process analysis identifying inefficiencies.
releases.goal: Establish core integrations and basic process analysis capabilities.
releases.name: Initial Integration & Process Analysis

releases.demo: Demonstrate risk assessment and AI system inventory features with audit logging.
releases.goal: Implement risk assessment and AI system inventory management.
releases.name: Risk & Governance Features

releases.demo: Showcase an automated workflow with human approval for high-risk actions.
releases.goal: Enable workflow automation with human-in-the-loop controls.
releases.name: Automation & Human Oversight

releases.demo: Demonstrate document upload and structured information extraction with ROI calculation.
releases.goal: Implement document intelligence and ROI calculation features.
releases.name: Document Intelligence & ROI Calculation

releases.demo: Show configurable governance controls and simulate a workflow using synthetic data.
releases.goal: Enhance governance controls and add workflow simulation capabilities.
releases.name: Advanced Governance & Simulation

stories.title: Enable Multi-Agent Orchestration for Process Operations
stories.narrative: As an operations manager, I want to orchestrate multiple agents for process, risk, and finance operations, so that I can ensure efficient and coordinated workflows.
acceptance: Given multiple agents are available, when I initiate a process operation, then the system orchestrates the agents to complete the operation.
Given an agent fails during orchestration, when the system detects the failure, then it reallocates tasks to other agents.
Trust: The system logs all orchestration activities for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement orchestration logic using Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace APIs to coordinate agent activities.

stories.title: Perform Process Analysis
stories.narrative: As a process analyst, I want to perform process analysis, so that I can identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
acceptance: Given a set of process data, when the analysis is initiated, then the system should provide a detailed report of inefficiencies.
Given an incomplete data set, when the analysis is attempted, then the system should notify the user of missing data.
Trust: The system logs all analysis activities with timestamps and user IDs for audit purposes.
failure_paths: User lacks permission to perform analysis
stories.task_guidance: Implement the process analysis module to handle data input, processing, and report generation. Ensure logging of all analysis activities in the audit trail.

stories.title: Implement Risk Assessment
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want OpsPilot to perform risk assessments, so that I can manage AI system risks effectively.
acceptance: Given AI systems are registered, When a risk assessment is performed, Then risks are identified and categorized.
Given AI systems are registered, When a risk assessment is performed, Then it suggests mitigation actions.
Trust: Risk assessment results are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Use Claude's risk-assessment skill to evaluate AI systems.

stories.title: Maintain AI System Inventory
stories.narrative: As an IT manager, I want OpsPilot to maintain an AI system inventory, so that I have a comprehensive view of all AI systems.
acceptance: Given AI systems are registered, When I view the inventory, Then it lists all systems with details.
Given AI systems are registered, When I update a system's status, Then the inventory reflects the change.
Trust: Inventory changes are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement inventory management using a PostgreSQL database.

stories.title: Enable Workflow Automation with Human Oversight
stories.narrative: As a process manager, I want OpsPilot to automate workflows with human oversight, so that high-risk actions are reviewed before execution.
acceptance: Given a workflow is automated, When a high-risk action is detected, Then it requires human approval.
Given a workflow is automated, When a low-risk action is detected, Then it executes automatically.
Trust: All automated actions are logged with risk levels.
stories.task_guidance: Use Claude's workflow-design skill to implement automation with approval gates.

stories.title: Log Actions for Audit Purposes
stories.narrative: As a security officer, I want OpsPilot to log all actions and decisions, so that I can audit system activities.
acceptance: Given an action is performed, When it is logged, Then it includes a timestamp and user ID.
Given a decision is made, When it is logged, Then it includes the decision rationale.
Trust: Logs are immutable and securely stored.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logging using a secure, append-only log system.

stories.title: Extract Structured Information from Documents
stories.narrative: As a user, I want OpsPilot to extract structured information from uploaded documents, so that I can easily access relevant data.
acceptance: Given a document is uploaded, When it is processed, Then structured information is extracted.
Given a document is uploaded, When it contains errors, Then the system flags it for review.
Trust: Document processing actions are logged.
stories.task_guidance: Use Claude's document-analysis skill to extract information from documents.

stories.title: Calculate Estimated ROI
stories.narrative: As a financial analyst, I want OpsPilot to calculate estimated ROI, so that I can assess the financial impact of automation.
acceptance: Given user assumptions are provided, When ROI is calculated, Then it shows estimated savings.
Given user assumptions are incorrect, When ROI is calculated, Then it flags potential errors.
Trust: ROI calculations are logged with assumptions.
stories.task_guidance: Implement ROI calculation using user-provided data and assumptions.

stories.title: Provide Configurable Governance Controls
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want OpsPilot to provide configurable governance controls, so that it can adapt to different jurisdictions.
acceptance: Given a jurisdiction is selected, When governance controls are configured, Then they reflect local regulations.
Given a jurisdiction is selected, When controls are misconfigured, Then the system alerts the user.
Trust: Configuration changes are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement governance configuration using a modular policy framework.

stories.title: Simulate Workflows Using Synthetic Data
stories.narrative: As a system tester, I want OpsPilot to simulate workflows using synthetic data, so that I can validate system behavior without real data.
acceptance: Given synthetic data is available, When a workflow is simulated, Then it executes as expected.
Given synthetic data is incorrect, When a workflow is simulated, Then it flags errors.
Trust: Simulation results are logged for review.
stories.task_guidance: Use Claude's workflow-design skill to simulate workflows with synthetic data.

stories.title: Provide Dashboard for Process Analysis Results
stories.narrative: As a data analyst, I want a dashboard to display process analysis results and automation opportunities, so that I can identify areas for improvement.
acceptance: Given process analysis data is available, when I access the dashboard, then I see the analysis results and automation opportunities.
Given no data is available, when I access the dashboard, then I see a message indicating no data is present.
Trust: The system logs all dashboard accesses and data views for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Create a dashboard interface that pulls data from the process analysis module and displays it to users.
